title: point_at
description: Aim the Asset's pointing equipment, such as a camera turret, at a position: target. Atlas gives only where to look. The Asset works out how to aim there from its own position, installation, and calibration. With latitude and longitude only, a fixed camera uses its installation height. For a target with altitudes, the camera must use a supplied reference it can resolve. If it cannot resolve any supplied reference, it refuses the Task with a reason. A fixed camera has no launch reference. The Task completes once the Asset observes the aim, and the Asset holds that aim until its next command.
